blueMarble.description: Preferred Blue Marble image with brighter oceans and seafloor detail. Replaces the previously downloaded July 2004 image.

encoding: RGB: Holdridge class (0 ocean, 254 unclassified land); bathymetry bin 0–4; SST v2 (0 unavailable; otherwise 1 + round((Celsius + 5) * 4)). No interpolation between classes.
notes: Holdridge is potential climate-defined vegetation, not observed contemporary cover. Marine classes are custom triangular seafloor-depth × surface-temperature groups: progressively fewer temperature divisions at greater depth. They are not Holdridge or measured deep-water biomes. Gray indicates missing source data. Display presets are custom aggregations. Source value 254 marks unclassified land and is displayed as missing data, never inferred as polar. Each preset has 3, 6, 10 or 15 classes arranged as rows of 1 through 2, 3, 4 or 5.

terrain.description: Pre-shaded topographic image; fixed lighting. Not a calibrated elevation raster.

height.description: User-supplied 8-bit grayscale composite of NASA Blue Marble topography and bathymetry in equirectangular projection, approximately 1.8 km per pixel at the equator. Relative brightness is not a calibrated elevation in metres.
height.processing: scripts/prepare-heightmap.py preserves the original and packages a reduced overview plus six full-resolution grayscale tiles with wrapped one-pixel gutters.
height.credit: Jesse Allen, NASA Earth Observatory, using GEBCO data produced by the British Oceanographic Data Centre

compositeProcessing.source: Processing description supplied by Alex Van de Sande
compositeProcessing.rationale: Approximately 56% brightness, chosen to place sea level between the combined Everest-to-Mariana-Trench range.
compositeProcessing.renderingNote: The app uses an independently adjustable sea-level threshold; it is not the original composite background value.

riverOverlay.description: Natural Earth 1:10m river/lake centerlines; all included ranks, styled by scalerank. Generalized major rivers and tributaries; not a complete stream network.

ecologyDisplay.sampling: Hexagonal cells in projected map coordinates, aligned to the sixth Gosper subgrid generation. Cell centers are projected to the source sphere before classification sampling.
ecologyDisplay.limitation: Changes the display pixel shape; does not add geographic information or increase native source resolution. Relief and rivers retain their original sampling.
